import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sqrt(eps)
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T + p[3]*np.log(T)
    b = p[4] + p[5]*T + p[6]/T
    c = p[7] + p[8]/T
    d = p[9]
    return a + b*s + c*eps + d*eps**2
